name: Integrated Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Integrated Industries Ltd is in the business of trading of food products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
IIL is in the business of Organic & Inorganic food products, ** Bakery Products, and other Processed food items**. In FY23, it acquired a running biscuit manufacturing plant in its subsidiary M/s Nurture Well Food Limited. NWFL manufactures Biscuits & Cookies under the brand name Richlite, Funtreat, and Crunchy Craze.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -21.2%
